# Tetris: An Explanation

Tetris is a classic tile-matching puzzle video game originally created in 1984 by Soviet software engineer Alexey Pajitnov. 

## Core Mechanics
1. **Tetriminos**: Geometric shapes composed of four square blocks each, falling down from the top of the playing field (matrix). There are 7 standard shapes, commonly named after letters of the alphabet that they resemble: **I**, **J**, **L**, **O**, **S**, **T**, and **Z**.
2. **Controls**: 
   - **Move Left / Right**: Shift the falling piece horizontally.
   - **Soft Drop**: Accelerate the descent of the piece.
   - **Hard Drop**: Instantly drop the piece to the bottom.
   - **Rotate**: Turn the piece clockwise or counter-clockwise to fit gaps.
3. **Line Clearing**: When a horizontal row of 10 blocks is completely filled with blocks and has no empty spaces, the row disappears, and all blocks above it shift down.
4. **Scoring & Leveling**: Clearing multiple lines at once (especially four lines at once, known as a **"Tetris"**) awards more points. As the player clears more lines, the game level increases, causing pieces to fall faster.
5. **Game Over**: The game ends when new tetriminos are prevented from entering the playfield because the stack has reached the top.

import os
import requests
from io import BytesIO
from PIL import Image
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

def download_image(url, filename):
    try:
        headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            img = Image.open(BytesIO(response.content)).convert('RGB')
            img.save(filename)
            return filename
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to download {url}: {e}")
    return None

os.makedirs("core_assets", exist_ok=True)

# Download some fun placeholder / arcade / tetris-like images
# 1. Cute puzzle blocks / colorful blocks
img1_path = download_image("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1550745165-9bc0b252726f?w=600", "core_assets/arcade.jpg")
# 2. Colorful building blocks / bricks
img2_path = download_image("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1587654780291-39c9404d746b?w=600", "core_assets/blocks.jpg")
# 3. Fun retro gaming
img3_path = download_image("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511512578047-dfb367046420?w=600", "core_assets/retro.jpg")

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(10)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]

def add_background(slide, color):
    bg = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height)
    bg.fill.solid()
    bg.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    bg.line.color.rgb = color

# Slide 1: Title Slide (Kid Friendly & Colorful)
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_background(slide1, RGBColor(20, 24, 82)) # Dark arcade blue

tb = slide1.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1), Inches(1.5), Inches(8), Inches(4))
tf = tb.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True

p = tf.paragraphs[0]
p.text = "🎮 Welcome to the Wonderful World of TETRIS! 🧩"
p.font.size = Pt(36)
p.font.bold = True
p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 230, 0) # Bright Yellow
p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

p2 = tf.add_paragraph()
p2.text = "\nA Super Fun Puzzle Game Full of Falling Blocks!"
p2.font.size = Pt(22)
p2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 255, 204) # Bright Cyan
p2.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

p3 = tf.add_paragraph()
p3.text = "\nLet's learn how to play and win! 🚀"
p3.font.size = Pt(18)
p3.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
p3.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER


# Slide 2: What is Tetris? (History & Origin)
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_background(slide2, RGBColor(245, 247, 250))

tb = slide2.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(0.6), Inches(8.4), Inches(1.2))
tf = tb.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
p = tf.paragraphs[0]
p.text = "🌟 What is Tetris?"
p.font.size = Pt(32)
p.font.bold = True
p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(20, 24, 82)

tb2 = slide2.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(2.0), Inches(5.2), Inches(4.5))
tf2 = tb2.text_frame
tf2.word_wrap = True

p = tf2.paragraphs[0]
p.text = "• Born in 1984! Tetris was created by a clever engineer named Alexey Pajitnov in the Soviet Union."
p.font.size = Pt(20)
p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(40, 40, 40)

p2 = tf2.add_paragraph()
p2.text = "\n• The name comes from 'Tetra' (meaning four) because every piece is made of 4 little squares joined together!"
p2.font.size = Pt(20)
p2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(40, 40, 40)

if img3_path and os.path.exists(img3_path):
    slide2.shapes.add_picture(img3_path, Inches(6.3), Inches(2.2), width=Inches(3.2))


# Slide 3: The Magical Shapes (Tetriminos)
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_background(slide3, RGBColor(240, 249, 255))

tb = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(0.5), Inches(8.4), Inches(1.0))
tf = tb.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
p = tf.paragraphs[0]
p.text = "🧱 Meet the 7 Magical Shapes!"
p.font.size = Pt(32)
p.font.bold = True
p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(20, 24, 82)

tb2 = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(1.6), Inches(5.2), Inches(5.4))
tf2 = tb2.text_frame
tf2.word_wrap = True

shapes_text = [
    "• I-Piece: The long straight hero! Great for clearing 4 lines at once.",
    "• O-Piece: A cute little yellow square that never rotates.",
    "• T-Piece: Shaped like a funny little hat or letter T.",
    "• L & J Pieces: Friendly boots pointing left and right.",
    "• S & Z Pieces: Wacky zig-zag shapes that love a challenge!"
]
for i, st in enumerate(shapes_text):
    p = tf2.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf2.add_paragraph()
    p.text = st
    p.font.size = Pt(18)
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(50, 50, 50)
    if i > 0:
        p.space_before = Pt(10)

if img2_path and os.path.exists(img2_path):
    slide3.shapes.add_picture(img2_path, Inches(6.3), Inches(2.0), width=Inches(3.2))


# Slide 4: How to Play (Controls)
slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_background(slide4, RGBColor(254, 243, 199)) # Warm yellow tint

tb = slide4.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(0.6), Inches(8.4), Inches(1.0))
tf = tb.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
p = tf.paragraphs[0]
p.text = "🎮 How Do We Control the Pieces?"
p.font.size = Pt(32)
p.font.bold = True
p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(180, 83, 9)

tb2 = slide4.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(1.8), Inches(8.4), Inches(5.0))
tf2 = tb2.text_frame
tf2.word_wrap = True

controls = [
    "⬅️ Move Left / Right: Slide your piece to the best spot.",
    "🔄 Rotate: Turn the block around to fit tricky gaps!",
    "⬇️ Soft Drop: Make the piece slide down a bit faster.",
    "🚀 Hard Drop: Zoom! Instantly drop the piece all the way to the bottom!"
]
for i, ct in enumerate(controls):
    p = tf2.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf2.add_paragraph()
    p.text = ct
    p.font.size = Pt(20)
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(60, 40, 20)
    if i > 0:
        p.space_before = Pt(14)


# Slide 5: The Magic of Line Clearing & Scoring
slide5 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_background(slide5, RGBColor(236, 253, 245)) # Mint green tint

tb = slide5.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(0.6), Inches(8.4), Inches(1.0))
tf = tb.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
p = tf.paragraphs[0]
p.text = "✨ Clearing Lines & Winning Points!"
p.font.size = Pt(32)
p.font.bold = True
p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(4, 120, 87)

tb2 = slide5.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(1.8), Inches(5.2), Inches(5.0))
tf2 = tb2.text_frame
tf2.word_wrap = True

points = [
    "• Fill a whole row with blocks with NO empty spaces, and... *POOF*! It disappears!",
    "• Clear 1 line = Good job!",
    "• Clear 4 lines at once using the 'I' piece = A 'TETRIS'! 🎉 Huge bonus points!",
    "• Warning: As you clear more lines, the game speeds up! Can you keep up?"
]
for i, pt_text in enumerate(points):
    p = tf2.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf2.add_paragraph()
    p.text = pt_text
    p.font.size = Pt(18)
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(20, 60, 40)
    if i > 0:
        p.space_before = Pt(10)

if img1_path and os.path.exists(img1_path):
    slide5.shapes.add_picture(img1_path, Inches(6.3), Inches(2.0), width=Inches(3.2))


# Slide 6: Game Over & Conclusion
slide6 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_background(slide6, RGBColor(254, 226, 226)) # Soft red/pink tint

tb = slide6.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(0.8), Inches(8.4), Inches(1.0))
tf = tb.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
p = tf.paragraphs[0]
p.text = "🏁 Watch Out & Have Fun!"
p.font.size = Pt(32)
p.font.bold = True
p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(185, 28, 28)

tb2 = slide6.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(2.0), Inches(8.4), Inches(4.5))
tf2 = tb2.text_frame
tf2.word_wrap = True

summary = [
    "⚠️ Game Over: If your stack of blocks reaches all the way to the top of the screen, the game ends!",
    "🧠 Brain Power: Tetris helps your brain practice quick thinking, matching, and problem solving.",
    "🏆 Ready to Play? Grab a game, stack those blocks high, and beat your high score! Good luck!"
]
for i, st in enumerate(summary):
    p = tf2.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf2.add_paragraph()
    p.text = st
    p.font.size = Pt(20)
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(80, 20, 20)
    if i > 0:
        p.space_before = Pt(16)

# Save presentation
prs.save("core/Tetris_Fun_Guide.pptx")
print("Presentation successfully saved to core/Tetris_Fun_Guide.pptx")
